relations.subject: Zenkei Blanche Hartman
relations.evidence: After taking up biochemistry and chemistry at the University of California she married Lou Hartman in 1947

relations.subject: Zenkei Blanche Hartman
relations.evidence: During the 1970s, Blanche received training in Nyoho-e – a traditional method for sewing Buddha's robe—in the lineage of Sawaki Kodo Roshi from Kasai Joshin Sensei, formerly of Antaiji.

relations.subject: Zenkei Blanche Hartman
relations.evidence: She and Lou were both ordained as priests by Zentatsu Richard Baker in 1977

relations.subject: Zenkei Blanche Hartman
relations.evidence: In 1988 she received shiho from Sojun Mel Weitsman

relations.subject: Zenkei Blanche Hartman
relations.evidence: From 1996 to 2002 she served two terms as co-abbess of the San Francisco Zen Center.

relations.subject: Zenkei Blanche Hartman
relations.evidence: This was the first female abbess of the City Center, having served just after Tenshin Reb Anderson and Sojun Mel Weitsman.
